metadata.purpose: Structural load-case, strength, stiffness and mass-feedback screening for the H2AIR-4+1 UAV using Phase-3 geometry and Phase-6 control-allocation implications.
metadata.fidelity_boundary: Beam/tube calculations are screening fidelity. CFRP is treated as an equivalent isotropic tube material; laminate orientation, joints, inserts, adhesive bonds, printed anisotropy, local buckling, fatigue, impact, vibration and aeroelasticity require supplier data/FEA/test evidence before flight release.
metadata.critical_rule: Strength PASS is not sufficient. Stiffness/deflection is a separate hard design gate. Unknown local mount geometry remains NOT_EVALUATED rather than being assumed safe.

load_cases.note: 6-DOF/control unequal rotor allocation at reference mass.

load_cases.name: 15kg_zero_pitch_design_VTOL
load_cases.note: Aero/propulsion total design thrust redistributed to zero pitch moment using 6-DOF/control CG/rotor geometry.

load_cases.name: dive_tail_download
load_cases.note: Horizontal-tail absolute CL design screen at configured dive speed.

load_cases.name: dive_crosswind_fin_load
load_cases.note: Twin-fin side-force structural screen at configured dive speed.

load_cases.name: combined_boom_tail_plus_rear_rotor
load_cases.note: Conservative envelope combining boom tail load with rear lift-rotor bending; simultaneous occurrence is a sizing envelope, not a trajectory claim.

load_cases.name: pusher_axial_design
load_cases.note: Pusher design thrust divided across two booms.

load_cases.name: single_motor_mount_limit
load_cases.note: Local motor-mount load requirement. Geometry/material absent, so stress remains NOT_EVALUATED.

load_cases.name: one_motor_out_remaining_motor_peak
load_cases.note: Structural local envelope for a surviving motor during motor-out recovery; flight controllability remains a 6-DOF/control/8 problem.

motor_mount.reason: Mount section geometry, fastener pattern, laminate/printed material orientation and bearing allowables are not controlled in the current model.

mass_feedback.warning: This is a partial structural-mass feedback only. It does not rescale wing skins/ribs/webs, mounts, pod or tails and is not the final coupled MTOW closure.
